question: How does the 'Shram Suvidha Portal' of the Ministry of Labour and Employment contribute to transparency in labour law enforcement?

options.text: By allowing women to work night shifts
By uploading inspection reports within 48 hours
By ensuring minimum wages for all employees

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Shram Suvidha Portal' contributes to transparency in labour law enforcement by **uploading inspection reports within 48 hours**.
 
• This ensures that inspection data is promptly available to all stakeholders, enhancing accountability and transparency.
 
• The portal helps in the effective implementation of labour laws and reduces the scope for manipulation and corruption.
 
• It also facilitates easier compliance for businesses by providing a single-window access to various labour law-related services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The portal is part of the Ministry of Labour and Employment's initiatives to streamline and simplify labour law compliance.
 
• It also provides a platform for workers to lodge grievances and track their status, further promoting transparency and accountability.
 
• The portal is integrated with various other government databases to ensure comprehensive and up-to-date information.
 
• It aims to reduce the compliance burden on businesses and improve the ease of doing business in India.
